title.narrative: The objective of the programme is to achieve joint underwriting of geothermal energy development risk by African (re)insurers, thereby enabling mobilisation of African investment capital for geothermal energy projects in Africa.

description.narrative: The objective of the programme is to achieve joint underwriting of geothermal energy development risk by African (re)insurers, thereby enabling mobilisation of African investment capital for geothermal energy projects in Africa.

participating-org.narrative:
FSD Africa is a specialist development agency working to make finance work for Africa’s future.
FSD Africa is incorporated as a non-profit company limited by guarantee in Kenya. It is funded by UK aid from the UK government.

owner-org.narrative: The objective of the programme is to achieve joint underwriting of geothermal energy development risk by African (re)insurers, thereby enabling mobilisation of African investment capital for geothermal energy projects in Africa.

recipient-country.narrative: roughly 15% of the programme benefits are expected to be in Ethiopia
roughly 85% of the programme benefits are expected to be in Kenya

description.narrative: The programme will be caried out in 3 workstreams. Workstream 1 start date beginning Q4 2021, end date end Q1 2022. Review & analysis of the insurance market in Kenya, Ethiopia and the key players across the African continent. See published disbursements schedule for quarterly disbursement values and anticipated payment dates.
